payout_quote: For every friend that joins Acorns Early, we'll add $50.00 to your parent account and your friend will get $10.00. The Refer a Friend reward will be issued 60 days after your friend activates their parent account and only if at least one children's card on the friend's account is activated and the account remains open for at least one calendar month following receipt of the reward. (Official Acorns Early Refer a Friend Terms & Conditions)
timing: Reward issued 60 days after the friend activates their parent account (and the account stays open one month past receipt)
eligibility: Referrer must be an existing GoHenry/Acorns Early customer with an Active account in Good Standing; referee must be a genuine person 18+, US resident (not PR/USVI), different physical address; one referrer per household; max 10 referral rewards per calendar year
steps: Open and activate your own Acorns Early parent account with at least one children's card
Share your referral with a friend who is a parent and wants a kids' debit account
Friend opens and activates their Acorns Early parent account and activates a children's card
Wait 60 days; the $50 posts to your parent account once their account stays open one month past receipt
catches: You must already be an Acorns Early customer - this is not a signup bonus, it's for existing users referring parents
Payout takes 60+ days after the friend activates, and their account must stay open a month after you receive the reward or it can be clawed back
Hard-capped at 10 referral rewards per calendar year ($500 max)
One referrer per household; the friend can't share your address
Only parents opening kids' accounts qualify - a narrow audience
US only, excluding Puerto Rico and US Virgin Islands
biggest_catch: You must already be a paying Acorns Early customer, the friend must be a parent who activates a kids' card, and you wait 60+ days for each $50 - capped at $500/year.

maximize: This only works if you're already an Acorns Early parent - don't subscribe just to refer. Your audience is other parents: PTA groups, parenting forums, and school chats where kids' debit cards are already a topic. Lead with the friend's $10, not your $50 - parents sign up for their kid's benefit. Track each referral's 60-day clock so you can confirm the $50 posted; with the 10-per-year cap, prioritize friends most likely to actually activate a card.
